heading: Bills to pay and things to do.
introEdit: Give a bill its next due date to be reminded before it's due, and keep a list of things to do for the house. Reminders show up in Alerts and by email, to the person they're for (or to everyone who can edit).
introView: Bills that are coming up and things to do for the house. You can see them, but only owners and editors can change them.

bills.title: Bills to pay
bills.subtitle: Your recurring bills from the Spending page. Set when the next one is due to be reminded.
bills.emptyLink: Add them on the Spending page
bills.logExpense: Also log it as an expense

tasks.title: Things to do
tasks.subtitle: Things to do for the house, once or on repeat. With a date, the person it's for gets a reminder.
tasks.dueHint: Needed for a task that repeats.
tasks.amountHint: With an amount it's a bill to pay.

list.title: Reminders
list.subtitle: Bills to pay and things to do, soonest first. Recurring bills come from the Spending page: give one a due date to be reminded.

errors.billGone: That bill no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.taskGone: That task no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.alreadyPaid: Someone already marked it as paid. Refresh the page.
errors.repeatNeedsDate: Pick the first date for a task that repeats.
errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, or leave it empty.

success.paidAndLogged: {title} marked as paid and logged as an expense.
